verdict.rationale: Otter documents its own background automations. The notetaker can be scheduled to auto-join all meetings, and transcripts, summaries and action items are pushed automatically to the CRM, Airtable, S3 and Drive. Pre-meeting briefings are delivered without user action, and community reports confirm the bot really does auto-join calls unattended. However, these are fixed-purpose meeting automations rather than a user-configurable automation or agent builder; general workflows rely on Zapier or the API. Missing for 10: a native, user-defined automation/rule builder with custom triggers and actions, scheduling of arbitrary recurring tasks, and in-depth docs on configuring and monitoring background automations.
